letter.company_line: Civil works, infrastructure and public domain projects for governments and developers across Australia
letter.subject: Application: Site Engineer, Sydney, Marc Masarate
paragraphs: I am applying for the Site Engineer role in Sydney that Regal Innovations listed on SEEK (job 95261196). Supporting site and project managers, ordering materials and keeping quality records on civil and public domain works is the kind of site role I want to build in Australia.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site, material and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). I have not yet worked on an Australian site or tracked variations and cost control on a job, and I would be learning those under your project managers.

I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney for this role.
I've attached my resume and cover letter. I would be glad to talk about the role.
